# Method SetVirtualDocumentMode

#### SetVirtualDocumentMode(DocumentId, bool)

Sets the virtual document mode.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 17, 0, 0)]
void SetVirtualDocumentMode(DocumentId inDocumentId, bool inIsOn)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Identifier of the document to modify.  |  
 
|  bool |  inIsOn |  Tells wether the document is virtual.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.17.
